questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] What method did ancient Chinese medical professionals use to immunize against smallpox?
A. Inhalation of powdered smallpox scabs
B. Drinking the sweat from someone who had smallpox
C. Rubbing ginger on the skin
Answer: A. This early form of inoculation was known as variolation.
questions.de: Wie wurde bei der frühen chinesischen Form der Pockenimpfung (Variolation) das pulverisierte Pockenschorf-Material verabreicht?
questions.en: In the early Chinese form of smallpox variolation, how was the powdered smallpox scab material given to the patient?

timeline.labelEn: Chinese physicians practise variolation by blowing powdered smallpox scabs up the nose, documented from the 16th century
timeline.labelDe: Chinesische Ärzte praktizieren die Variolation, indem sie pulverisierten Pockenschorf in die Nase blasen, belegt ab dem 16. Jahrhundert

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed (nasal insufflation of powdered scabs). 'Ancient' is loose: Chinese variolation is documented from the 16th century (some sources claim the 11th), i.e. Ming dynasty, not antiquity.

questions.cardText:
[Economics] Which of the following countries is NOT one of the BRIC nations?
A. Russia
B. Brazil
C. Indonesia
Answer: C. The term “BRIC” refers to four rapidly developing countries—Brazil, Russia, India, and China—that are recognized for their significant influence on regional and global affairs.
questions.de: Welche vier Länder bilden die BRIC-Gruppe aufstrebender Volkswirtschaften?
questions.en: Which four countries make up the BRIC group of emerging economies?

timeline.labelEn: Goldman Sachs economist Jim O'Neill coins the term BRIC for Brazil, Russia, India and China
timeline.labelDe: Der Goldman-Sachs-Ökonom Jim O'Neill prägt den Begriff BRIC für Brasilien, Russland, Indien und China

questions.notes: Card's answer confirmed (Indonesia is not a BRIC country). Reworked from a 'which is NOT' question to the positive fact. Not to be confused with the later BRICS organisation (South Africa from 2010).
